reasons.unworldly-bellow-red: Banishing 3 random cards from the graveyard single-handedly turns on the whole deck's '6 or more {p} banished this turn' triggers while buffing the next Brute/Shadow attack +4{p} with go again.
reasons.writhing-beast-hulk-red: Another banish-3-from-graveyard enabler that converts the 6+{p} hit into dominate, and its blood debt feeds Doomsday's count and Hexagore's damage reduction.
reasons.endless-maw-red: Banishes 3 random graveyard cards for a repeatable +3{p} payoff and adds a blood debt card to the banished zone.
reasons.shadow-of-blasmophet-red: The draw/discard fills the graveyard for your banish-3 effects and the 6+{p} discard searches and banishes a blood debt card, permanently growing your banished zone.
reasons.goremass-summoning-blue: Cheapest way to make the Blasmophet token that Consuming Lash demands, and it triggers off the banishing your deck already does, with go again.
reasons.shaden-scream-red: Banishing from hand both triggers 'put into your banished zone' conditions and powers a +5{p} Brute/Shadow attack with go again.
reasons.blood-dripping-frenzy-blue: Converts a hand full of blood debt cards into cards drawn and a massive global power boost scaled to how many 6+{p} cards get banished.
reasons.rumbling-hunger-red: On hit it creates the Blasmophet token Consuming Lash needs and gains go again whenever you've banished a 6+{p} card, which is this deck's default.
reasons.convulsions-from-the-bellows-of-hell-red: Graveyard banish enabler that turns the 6+{p} trigger into +3{p} and dominate on your next attack.
reasons.deep-rooted-evil-yellow: Playable directly from the banished zone once you've banished a 6+{p} card, giving free recursive attacks while stacking blood debt.
